device.category: matrix-patched analogue synthesizer with digital patch memory, piano-roll sequencer and DSP effects
device.based_on: Successor to the Erica Synths SYNTRX (a re-imagining of the EMS Synthi AKS, approved by Peter Zinovieff; 1056 units).

sources.title: Erica Synths SYNTRX II User Manual (March 2023)
sources.note: Features, connections, every 'module', matrix connections, patch memory, sequencer and stepped modulation, six example patches, MIDI and configuration settings.

architecture.polyphony_mode: monophonic; paraphonic patches with CV2 on Oscillator 2
architecture.patch_memory_note: 256 matrix patches (connections and gain levels, sequence, stepped modulation and per-patch settings); knob positions are not stored. The last patch is autosaved every 30 s.
architecture.routing: 16 x 16 analogue matrix under digital control; three gain levels per point
architecture.summary: Sources (matrix rows): Osc 1 pulse and sine, Osc 2 (pulse and saw mixed), Osc 3 triangle/ramp, Osc 3 pulse or S&H, noise, Input 1, envelope follower, Input 2, filter, Trapezoid CV, Trapezoid VCA output, ring mod, effects, and joystick Y and X. Destinations (matrix columns): Ch1 and Ch2 outputs, scope, Trapezoid VCA input, ring mod A, effects, filter, the three oscillator pitches, oscillator shape, S&H input, envelope decay, filter frequency and both output levels. Nothing sounds until a patch is made. The matrix also becomes a 16-step piano-roll sequencer with two stepped modulation lanes added to the joystick.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: Audio oscillator, about C0-C8, with sine and pulse each on its own matrix row; shape for each (pulse width; sine to sharkfin either way), octave ±3, tune about two octaves.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: Audio oscillator with pulse and saw (to 'dual super saw') mixed to one row; shape, octave ±3, tune; hard sync to Osc 1; CV2 input takes over its pitch.

modules.name: Oscillator 3
modules.description: LFO into audio range (0.05-500 Hz): triangle/ramp and pulse with shape; free or keyboard-following.

modules.name: Random (sample and hold)
modules.description: Samples the matrix S&H input at its own rate or on each gate; shares a matrix row with Osc 3 pulse.

modules.name: Osc 3 / S&H selector
modules.description: Chooses whether row 5 carries Osc 3 pulse or the S&H output.

modules.name: Noise generator
modules.description: Zener-diode white noise with a tone (colour) control.

modules.name: Input 1 and envelope follower
modules.description: External audio input with level, and an envelope follower giving a CV (attenuverted) and a gate (threshold, to the gate OR).

modules.name: Input 2
modules.description: DC-coupled external input, line or mic gain, level (overdrives at high settings), direct or inverted.

modules.name: Filter
modules.description: High-pass and low-pass in series: LPF fully open gives HP, HPF fully closed gives LP, anything else band-pass. Resonance self-oscillates (pure sine) from 7.

modules.name: Ring modulator
modules.description: Four-quadrant multiplier: A from the matrix; B (the carrier) chosen internally by the SOURCE B rotary switch, whose positions the manual does not list.

modules.name: Oscillator shape CV
modules.description: Matrix Oscillator Shape input, sent to Osc 1 and Osc 2 according to their shape switches.

modules.name: Trapezoid envelope
modules.description: Looping attack (6-850 ms), on (0-1.5 s), decay (16 ms-2 s, voltage controlled) and off (14 ms-1.3 s). OFF above 9 stops looping: then gates or the GATE button fire it.

modules.name: Trapezoid VCA
modules.description: VCA driven by the Trapezoid; its input is the 'Envelope Signal' matrix column.

modules.name: Effects
modules.description: DSP delay or reverb (with 112dB): time or size, feedback (self-oscillating delay; looping reverb), level; wet only. Time knob motion recordable for 8 s.

modules.name: Joystick
modules.description: Two bipolar CVs (±5 V) with X and Y levels; motion and gate patterns recordable for 8 s; MIDI CCs and the sequencer's stepped lanes add to it.

modules.name: CV, gate, MIDI and sequencer
modules.description: CV1 (all oscillators), CV2 (Osc 2), gate input, MIDI note (high-note priority, added to CV), GATE button and the piano-roll sequencer, ORed gates.

modules.name: Scope (meter) and scope output
modules.description: Meter for audio or CV, with its own output jack, normalled to both inputs.

modules.name: Output channel 1
modules.description: Output VCA with level (plus matrix CV), tone filter and pan.

modules.name: Output channel 2
modules.description: Output VCA with level (plus matrix CV), tone filter and pan.

modules.name: Outputs
modules.description: Panned sum of both channels to outputs 1 and 2 and headphones.

patch_matrix.note: Digitally controlled analogue mixer/buffered multiple: up to 16 inputs mix into one column without loss, one row feeds up to 16 columns. Letters A-P and numbers 1-16 are for reference; the panel labels rows and columns by name. Column order follows the panel; the order of S&H Input and Decay is read from the panel art. Oscillator Shape reaches Osc 1 and Osc 2 according to their shape switches; Filter Frequency reaches HPF, LPF or both per its switch. Row 3 carries Osc 2's pulse and saw already mixed by their levels.

example_patches.name: Basic patch
example_patches.description: Osc 1 pulse and sine to channel 1. Set channel 1 level, pan centre.

example_patches.name: Filtered oscillator
example_patches.description: Osc 1 pulse through the filter to channel 1.

example_patches.name: Looping VCA
example_patches.description: Osc 1 pulse, filter, Trapezoid VCA, channel 1: the looping envelope pulses the level.

example_patches.name: Modulation madness
example_patches.description: As the looping VCA patch, with Osc 3 triangle/ramp on filter frequency, joystick X on oscillator shape (Osc 1 pulse width) and joystick Y on Osc 1 pitch. Record joystick motion for automation.

example_patches.name: Stereo panning
example_patches.description: Osc 1 pulse to both channels (ch 1 panned left, ch 2 right). Osc 3 triangle to the scope and channel 1 level; the scope output is normalled to Input 2, set to LINE and INVERT, which drives channel 2 level: an auto-pan.

example_patches.name: Dry/wet effects
example_patches.description: Osc 1 pulse through the Trapezoid VCA to channel 1 (dry) and to the effects, whose wet output also goes to channel 1.

indicators.label: envelope follower gate LED
indicators.function: Lit when a gate is detected.

indicators.label: joystick LEDs
indicators.function: Bicolour feedback of the recorded CVs.

indicators.label: SCOPE meter
indicators.function: Audio level (to about 4.5 V) or bipolar CV.

behaviours.name: Patching
behaviours.rule: No sound until a patch is made. Move with the X/Y encoders (or SHIFT + joystick); the left encoder cycles gain 1, 0.7, 0.3, off; the right toggles gain 1 or off. SHIFT + encoder previews a point while held; SHIFT + right encoder + joystick draws points.

behaviours.name: Patch memory
behaviours.rule: 256 patches: SAVE, choose a slot, push an encoder; RECALL to load; < PATCH > to step through; SHIFT + PATCH > for a random patch within the set density and area. Autosaves every 30 s. Knob positions are not stored.

behaviours.name: Trapezoid
behaviours.rule: Loops attack, on, decay, off by default; OFF above 9 makes it one-shot, fired by gates, the envelope follower or the GATE button. With an external gate, ON is the gate length. Decay is voltage controlled; the built-in VCA takes the Envelope Signal column.

behaviours.name: Filter
behaviours.rule: HPF and LPF in series: LPF at 10 is pure high-pass, HPF at 0 pure low-pass, otherwise band-pass with adjustable width and centre. Audio-rate modulation works; resonance from 7 makes a sine oscillator.

behaviours.name: Effects are wet only
behaviours.rule: Send the dry signal and the effects row to the same output for a mix. TIME knob motion can be recorded (8 s, not saved).

behaviours.name: Sequencer
behaviours.rule: SHIFT + GATE/SEQ turns the matrix into a 16-step piano roll: rows 1-12 semitones (three octaves by brightness), row 13 length, rows 14-16 gate length (15-100%). The CV goes to all oscillators. Two stepped modulation lanes (21 levels, ±5 V) add to joystick Y and X. Saved with the patch.

behaviours.name: Joystick and MIDI CCs
behaviours.rule: Joystick X and Y (±5 V by their levels) appear on rows 16 and 15; MIDI CCs (default 70 and 71) and the stepped lanes add to them. Motion and gate patterns record for 8 s and overdub.

behaviours.name: MIDI and CV
behaviours.rule: One MIDI note at a time, high-note priority; MIDI note CV adds to CV1/CV2. Mod wheel and velocity reach the filter cutoff; pitch bend range 0-12. SHIFT + REC/CLEAR for 3 s sends MIDI panic.

receives.note: high-note priority; velocity to filter cutoff (VELC)

midi.channel_note: Channel 1-16 or 0 (omni); MIDI THRU passes input on.

specifications.filter: HP and LP in series, resonant
specifications.envelope: Trapezoid: attack 6-850 ms, on 0-1.5 s, decay 16 ms-2 s, off 14 ms-1.3 s
specifications.effects: delay (to 0.5 s or 3 s) and reverb, tape or BBD mode

omitted_from_source: interface illustration labels beyond control names
not_in_source: matrix column order beyond the panel art
source_inconsistencies: Input 1's normalling text says the scope output is routed 'if nothing is patched into the INPUT 2 jack', copied from the Input 2 text.
The factory reset text says the 'firmware update screen will appear' and 'proceed with the FW update', in a reset procedure.
The joystick is on 'pins 15 and 16' of the matrix; the matrix list gives vertical then horizontal, taken here as rows 15 (Y) and 16 (X).
The modulation example calls Osc 3's output a sawtooth; its row is the triangle/ramp wave.

modelling_gaps.detail: Letters and numbers are added for reference; the panel uses names only.
Step data (notes, gates, stepped lanes) is described, not modelled as parameters.
Joystick, gate and TIME recordings (8 s each) are performance data and not saved.
